g.text: Seed 132 · complete custody histories from the existing 6,000-second traces
Custody includes applications waiting in NWK and already admitted to HOP. Panel scales differ.
For the observed first receptions, DACK is selected when the same flow has ≥16 owners before arrival.
The curves show autonomous histories; equal application identities or causal effects of a code change are not assumed.
